title: Report a board outline's bounding width and height
summary: Opens a PcbDoc by path (or takes the current board), gets it with GetPCBBoardByPath and reports the board outline's bounding width and height in mils, millimetres and internal units.
phrasings: open a PcbDoc by path and read its board

commands.name: GetPcbSize
commands.description: Report the board outline width and height
commands.params: PCBFile=<path to .PcbDoc> (optional; default: the current board)|Out=<file or folder> (optional)
